The `serverless.yml` file will be used to configure the Serverless framework. This file will define the function settings, environment variables, and API Gateway configuration.

```yml
service:
  name: my-microservice

provider:
  name: aws
  region: us-east-1

functions:
  createResource:
    handler: src/handlers/create-resource.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /resources
          method: post
